authoring.name: Repair Kit
authoring.description: Orange rigid repair case with dark corner guards, two metal latches, hinged lid and five fitted tool compartments.
notes: Reference: repair-kit-v1.png; the frozen orange hard case overrides the historical mint soft-bag prompt. S=.28 miniature metre scale.
Front is -Y, the back hinge runs along X. Open the lid to -1.92 radians about X, and release the two separate latches first.
The body has a real rounded tub, floor and walls, and the lid is a distinct rigid node with carry handle and latch children.
Five tray compartments hold simplified wrench, screwdriver, hollow tape roll, coiled cable and folded mint cloth. All are closed 3D components with physical depth.
Tools are merged static accessories for the current one-use repair behavior; no additional pickup gameplay is implied.
